entities.title: .dev.vars.example still lists the old OAuth secrets
entities.summary: The example settings keep commented GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, GITHUB_CLIENT_ID and GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET lines that nothing reads.
entities.compromise: They were left when sign-in moved to icelander.net's login service.
entities.cost: A developer may think local sign-in needs OAuth credentials; only DEV_LOGIN matters locally.
acceptanceCriteria: .dev.vars.example names only settings the Worker reads.

origin.description: The commented lines, against worker/auth.ts and worker/mail.ts.

entities.title: Rename the slug and path from chess to gambit-chess
entities.summary: The folder, the Worker, BASE and the address /games/retro/chess become gambit-chess.
acceptanceCriteria: Gambit is served at /games/retro/gambit-chess/, and the old address redirects there.
Invitation links already sent (?challenge=ID at the old address) still open their invitation.
The database keeps its data; any rename of it goes through docs/database-migrations.md.
